title: Cones over integer multiplicity currents are integer multiplicity
statement: Fix P, m ∈ ℕ and assume (H_push): for every integer multiplicity Z ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^{P+1}) and every C^∞ map f : ℝ^{P+1} → ℝ^P with f⁻¹(K) ∩ spt Z compact for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, there is an integer multiplicity S ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with S(ω) = Z(η) whenever ω ∈ D^{m+1}(ℝ^P), η ∈ D^{m+1}(ℝ^{P+1}) and η(y) = ω(f(y))∘Df(y) (i.e. (ω(f y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f y)) for all y in an open set containing spt Z. Let R ∈ ℝ, X ∈ D_m(ℝ^P) integer multiplicity with spt X ⊆ B̄_R(0), and C ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with Cone(X, C), i.e. C(ω) = X(ψ) whenever ω ∈ D^{m+1}(ℝ^P), ψ ∈ D^m(ℝ^P) and ψ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 t^m ω(tx)(x, v) dt for all x in some open N ⊇ spt X and all v ∈ (ℝ^P)^m. Then C is integer multiplicity.
